recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future replacement/linking behavior for Practitioner or RelatedPerson should be handled by a new Patient Administration or relevant work-group change request rather than by broadening this FHIR-I extension.
issue_request: The Published FHIR-core issue asked whether http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/replaces could be used to link deactivated/replacement Practitioner and RelatedPerson resources. Its Not Persuasive with Modification resolution clarified that replaces is only for separate conformance resource instances superseded by the current instance, and should not be expanded to clinical or business resources such as Practitioner, RelatedPerson, or Patient.
initial_application: Core commit 717efcafe7e30a3ae02997bd0f38386229098110, merged by 4dd712a7214ecbd144a3018c92d88dfb8cb7268a, changed the replaces row in source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml from a generic replacing-resource definition to the approved conformance-resource description.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-04-25 record the issue as canonical-resource-only and Not persuasive with modification, 10-0-0. Core later removed extension definitions from the R5 source, and source/history.html documents their move to the hl7.fhir.uv.extensions package. The current Extension Pack replaces definition carries the approved description and context list, excluding Practitioner and RelatedPerson.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The active core checkout no longer owns the replaces StructureDefinition, and the Extension Pack source already matches the FHIR-33001 decision.
